records.text: Brooklyn Beckham accused his parents of attacking him privately and publicly through press leaks and said his brothers were sent to attack him on social media.
records.speaker: Brooklyn Beckham

appearances.snippet: goes on, since the moment that I started standing up for myself with my family, ... I've received endless attacks from my parents, both privately and publicly, that were sent to the press on their orders. ... Even my brothers were sent to attack me on social media before they ultimately blocked me out of nowhere this last summer.

verification.notes: The full contemporaneous reproduction of Beckham's Instagram statement includes his claims of private and public attacks, press leaks ordered by his parents, and social-media attacks by his brothers. This verifies what he publicly alleged, not the truth of the family conduct.

sources.title: Brooklyn Beckham’s bombshell statement in full as he hits out at ‘controlling’ parents
sources.relevance: Reproduces the press and social-media allegations.
